notes_for_editor: Thin record: two list entries, one 1952 survey note and the FFLA listing. Height conflicts (100 ft table vs about 80 ft in 1952 note). Coe Lake relocation is only a possibility and is worded that way. The statewide list has a stray line 'Another name for the Thorpe lookout.' between the Makinen and Mantrap Valley entries; placement is ambiguous (probably Mantrap Valley, which the Thorpe entry lists as an alias), so it is not used. The county list also names McClintock Marshall Co. in the entry with no explanation; not used. Removal range 1961-1966 is recorded with 1966 as the event year (later bound). Used three searches, one over the per-tower budget.
